claim: Thai traditional consonant-letter inventory contains 44 letters
Standard Thai has five lexical tones
Core final consonant phonemes are represented by nine categories including glides and glottal stop
Thai orthographic order is not identical to phonological constituent order
ห นำ can change the effective consonant-class environment and requires lexical/contextual analysis
Thai written consonant sequences may represent true clusters
Standard Thai complex onsets are structurally restricted; arbitrary adjacent consonants are not licensed as a generic complex onset
